mapper.select: SELECT n.id,COALESCE(NULLIF(n.type,''),'run') AS type, COALESCE(NULLIF(n.title,''), CASE WHEN r.status='failure' THEN '查寝失败' ELSE '查寝成功' END) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(n.message,''),r.message,'') AS message, r.status,COALESCE(r.started_at,n.created_at) AS time,COALESCE(r.duration_ms,0) AS duration_ms, n.run_id AS runId,n.read_at FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.id=n.run_id WHERE n.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET read_at=#{readAt} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
UPDATE notifications SET read_at=#{readAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
